instruction: A single cowboy boot folded from stiff cardstock, its faceted shaft, pointed toe, and angular heel formed by creased paper polygons. Tan and turquoise printed panels imitate tooled stitching, with tiny folded spur and pull-strap details and soft cast shadows in the paper valleys.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Cowboy Boot in a papercraft style. A single cowboy boot folded from stiff cardstock, its faceted shaft, pointed toe, and angular heel formed by creased paper polygons. Tan and turquoise printed panels imitate tooled stitching, with tiny folded spur and pull-strap details and soft cast shadows in the paper valleys. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
